suleyman.name: Gazi Mustafa Kemal

base.name: Decree
base.text: When Lobbying ends, swap a Minister for an eligible player, even under Ratification. They draw 1 Intrigue card.

suleyman.flavor: Sovereignty is the nation's, without condition.

hurrem.name: Latife Hanım

base.name: Lady of the House
base.text: At the Praise or Reproof, you choose which Minister it falls on, instead of the Gazi.

favor.name: Unveiled
favor.text: In one wave, play two cards instead of one.

hurrem.flavor: The Gazi's wife, the Republic's first lady.

ibrahim.name: İsmet Pasha

base.name: Forming the Cabinet
base.text: This crisis, you appoint both Ministers instead of the Gazi. You may appoint yourself.

favor.name: Second Man
favor.text: From now on, gain 1 Standing whenever a Reform passes while you are a Minister.

ibrahim.flavor: At the head of Lausanne, then of the cabinet.

sahsultan.name: Kâzım Karabekir

base.name: Progressive Party
base.text: On your turn to censure, censure for free and choose the replacement. It counts as your Censure this crisis.

favor.name: Blacklist
favor.text: Name a player: next crisis they can't become a Minister by any route.

sahsultan.flavor: He took Kars; in 1924 he founded the first opposition party.

mustafa.name: Fevzi Pasha

base.name: General Staff
base.text: When Lobbying ends, before the Decree, take a Minister's seat if eligible, even under Ratification.

favor.name: Father of the Army
favor.text: Whoever censures you gives you the Standing they paid.

mustafa.flavor: Chief of the General Staff; the army stays out of politics.

hatice.name: Fethi Bey

base.name: Tolerance
base.text: Before Lobbying, pick a player: this crisis Intrigue can't unseat them, and they lose no Standing, Reproof included.

favor.name: Letter from Paris
favor.text: Pick two players other than the Gazi and you. Secretly learn if they share a side.

hatice.flavor: Prime Minister in 1924-25, then envoy in Paris.

base.name: Çankaya Table
base.text: Before the Gazi appoints, talk with him alone for one minute.

favor.name: Endorsement
favor.text: When a wave flips, move one Intrigue card played on you to another player.

barbaros.name: Rauf Bey

base.name: Hamidiye Raid
base.text: Take 1 random Intrigue card from another player's hand, then discard to your limit.

favor.name: Ship's Log
favor.text: After the Vote, secretly see what the Prime Minister discarded.

barbaros.flavor: Hamidiye's captain; a founder of the Progressives.

gritti.name: Cavid Bey

base.name: Interest
base.text: Name a player. The next time they gain Standing, you gain 1 too.

favor.name: Lausanne File
favor.text: Secretly look at the top 3 Bills. You may put one on the bottom.

gritti.flavor: Former finance minister; an adviser on the Lausanne debts.

sarlken.name: Abdülmecid Efendi

base.name: Abdication
base.text: At Appoint, before any Censure, give your Minister seat to an eligible player. Gain 1 Standing; don't draw.

favor.name: Caliph of the Faithful
favor.text: Your Intrigue cards count as cards of an open field.

sarlken.flavor: The last caliph, and a painter; exiled in 1924.

tahmasp.name: Venizelos

base.name: Aegean Front
base.text: When the Crisis card flips, choose this crisis's field: Assembly, Çankaya or Ankara.

favor.name: Megali Idea
favor.text: Everyone, you included, keeps 1 Intrigue card of their choice and discards the rest.

tahmasp.flavor: Greece's prime minister; he signed the 1930 friendship treaty.

daye.name: Recep Peker
daye.text: Play an Intrigue card as Assembly Resolution. You can't choose yourself.
daye.flavor: The party's secretary-general writes the decision.

bali.name: Salih Bozok
bali.text: Play an Intrigue card as Ratification.
bali.flavor: Childhood friend and aide; he never lets go.

ayas.name: Kâzım Özalp
ayas.text: Play an Intrigue card as Cabinet Reshuffle.
ayas.flavor: Speaker from 1924; he reads the appointments out.

matrakci.name: Refet Pasha
matrakci.text: Play an Intrigue card as Plain-Clothes Man.
matrakci.flavor: The first Minister of the Interior; he knows who visits whom.

sumbul.name: Mahmut Esat
sumbul.text: Play an Intrigue card as Immunity. You choose its field.
sumbul.flavor: Minister of Justice, author of the Civil Code.

nigar.name: Ali Fuat Pasha
nigar.text: Play an Intrigue card as Cipher Telegram.
nigar.flavor: Once envoy in Moscow; he knows the cipher.

ebussuud.name: Tevfik Rüştü
ebussuud.text: Play an Intrigue card as Inquiry.
ebussuud.flavor: Doctor and deputy; he reads the discarded papers too.

gulsah.name: Ahmet Ağaoğlu
gulsah.text: Play an Intrigue card as Press Campaign.
gulsah.flavor: The sharpest pen in the Ankara papers.

seker.name: Safiye Ali
seker.text: Play an Intrigue card as Doctor's Note.
seker.flavor: Turkey's first woman doctor; nobody argues with her notes.

gulfem.name: Nuri Conker
gulfem.text: Play an Intrigue card as Guarantor.
gulfem.flavor: The Gazi's childhood friend; he shares his man's fate.

iskender.name: Abdülhalik Renda
iskender.text: Play an Intrigue card as Supplementary Bill.
iskender.flavor: Minister of Finance; there is always room for one more bill.

firuze.name: Nezihe Muhiddin
firuze.text: Play an Intrigue card as Headline.
firuze.flavor: President of the Turkish Women's Union; she picks the headline.

gulaga.name: Makbule Hanım
gulaga.text: Play an Intrigue card as Censor.
gulaga.flavor: The Gazi's sister; she keeps the house quiet.

lokman.name: Halide Edib
lokman.text: Play an Intrigue card as Switchboard.
lokman.flavor: Novelist and corporal; she hears first who called whom.

akil-hocasi.name: Immunity
akil-hocasi.text: For this crisis, cancels the other Intrigue cards of its field placed on this player.
akil-hocasi.flavor: What's said at the rostrum stays there.

muhur.name: Ratification
muhur.text: Place on a Minister. Intrigue cards can't replace them this crisis; the Decree still can.
muhur.flavor: The seal is down; it's done.

valide.name: Assembly Resolution
valide.text: Place on a Minister. Replace them with an eligible player, yourself included. The new player takes the same seat.

azil.name: Cabinet Reshuffle
azil.text: Place on a Minister. The Gazi replaces them with an eligible player, who takes the same seat.

casus.name: Plain-Clothes Man
casus.text: When Lobbying ends, secretly see every Intrigue card this player played this crisis, and on whom.
casus.flavor: In Ulus every step has a shadow.

muhurlu-evrak.name: Cipher Telegram
muhurlu-evrak.text: Secretly look at the top 3 Bills and put them back in the same order.
muhurlu-evrak.flavor: News reaches the clerk before its owner.

saray-tabibi.name: Doctor's Note
saray-tabibi.text: This player loses no Standing this crisis, Reproof included.
saray-tabibi.flavor: The sick answer to no one.

iftira.name: Press Campaign
iftira.flavor: A column, a name, a stain.

kefalet.name: Guarantor
kefalet.text: Place on a Minister. If they still hold a seat at the Vote: you gain 1 Standing on a Reform, lose 1 on a Reaction.
kefalet.flavor: Whoever stands surety signs the note too.

teftis.name: Inquiry
teftis.text: Place on a Minister. After the Vote, secretly look at the card or cards that Minister discarded.
teftis.flavor: The committee reads every paper, even the bin.

defterdar.name: Supplementary Bill
defterdar.text: Place on the Prime Minister. If still Prime Minister at the Vote, they draw 4 instead of 3 and discard 2.
defterdar.flavor: One more item on the agenda.

nobet.name: Switchboard
nobet.text: When Lobbying ends, pick one card others played on this player this crisis; secretly learn who played it.
nobet.flavor: The switchboard knows who placed the call.

nazar.name: Headline
nazar.text: Place on a Minister. If this crisis's Praise or Reproof falls on them, it counts 2 Standing instead of 1.
nazar.flavor: A headline makes a name or breaks it.

sukut.name: Censor
sukut.text: This player can't play an Intrigue card in the next wave.
sukut.flavor: The column comes out blank; readers understand.

divanda-nufuz.name: Bring Down a Minister
divanda-nufuz.text: Remove a Minister from their seat with an Intrigue card.
divanda-nufuz.flavor: A Minister sits by one vote and falls by one.

suphe.name: Under Suspicion
suphe.text: Be a Minister when a Reaction passes.

takdir.name: Party to Reform
takdir.text: Be a Minister when a Reform passes.
takdir.flavor: Your signature is on the reform too.

gozden.name: Fall from Favour
gozden.flavor: The door of the house closes only once.

kulisci.name: Lobbyist
kulisci.text: Place Intrigue cards on 3 different players.

yukselen.name: A Seat in Cabinet
yukselen.flavor: One cabinet is luck; the second is skill.

itirazci.name: Moving Censure
itirazci.flavor: "Mr Speaker, I ask for the floor!"

hedef.name: Talk of the Town
hedef.text: Have other players place 2 or more Intrigue cards on you in one crisis.
hedef.flavor: No paper goes to print without your name.

ortak.name: Comrade in Arms
ortak.text: Place a Ratification or a Guarantor on a Minister.
ortak.flavor: Side by side at the front, side by side in the Assembly.

hazine.name: Mobilisation
hazine.text: Play 3 Intrigue cards in one crisis.
hazine.flavor: Everything you have, on the table.

koltuk.name: Grab a Seat
koltuk.text: Become a Minister through an Intrigue card.

kulak.name: Eavesdropper
kulak.text: Use Plain-Clothes Man, Cipher Telegram, Inquiry or Switchboard.
kulak.flavor: The walls of the house have ears.

yeniceri.name: Sheikh Said Revolt
yeniceri.text: Players with 0 Standing draw 1 Intrigue card each.
yeniceri.flavor: February 1925: a revolt in the east; the army marches.

hazine.name: The Public Debt
hazine.text: Nobody draws an Intrigue card this crisis.
hazine.flavor: The Ottoman debt still has to be paid.

venedik.name: Embassies to Ankara
venedik.text: The two players beside the Gazi draw 1 Intrigue card each.
venedik.flavor: The envoys arrive; the town has no hotels.

harem.name: A Quarrel at the House
harem.text: Least Standing draws 1 Intrigue card; on a tie, the Gazi picks.

macar.name: Martial Law
macar.text: Nobody draws an Intrigue card this crisis.
macar.flavor: February 1925: martial law in the east, silence in Ankara.

muhur.name: The Missing Cipher
muhur.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.
muhur.flavor: A cipher book is missing from the house.

divan.name: The Opposition Party
divan.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.
divan.flavor: November 1924: the first opposition party takes its seats.

sehzade.name: The Succession
sehzade.text: The two players beside the Gazi draw 1 Intrigue card each.

istanbul.name: The Hat Law
istanbul.text: Everyone except the Gazi draws 1 Intrigue card.
istanbul.flavor: November 1925: every coffeehouse has an opinion.

irakeyn.name: The Mosul Question
irakeyn.text: Least Standing draws 1 Intrigue card; on a tie, the Gazi picks.
irakeyn.flavor: The League of Nations has decided.

isabella.name: The Dynasty Exiled
isabella.text: Last crisis's Ministers draw 1 Intrigue card each.
isabella.flavor: March 1924: the dynasty has days to leave.

h.name: Reform
text: Praise: the Gazi gives a Minister 1 Standing.

x.name: Reaction
text: Reproof: the Gazi takes 1 Standing from a Minister.
x.flavor: "Pasha, I swear I did all I could; the Assembly wouldn't pass it!"

loyalist.name: Reformist
text: You win when 4 Reforms are on the Reform track.

traitor.name: Reactionary
text: You win when 5 Reactions are on the Reaction track.
traitor.flavor: The old days will come back.

sorusturma.name: Independence Tribunal
sorusturma.text: The Gazi names an inspector, who secretly looks at one player's Allegiance card, then may say anything.

hazineDefteri.name: Police Report
hazineDefteri.text: Before the next crisis, the Gazi names a player, who secretly looks at the top 3 Bills.

fermanRefresh.name: Law on the Maintenance of Order
fermanRefresh.text: The Gazi may use the Decree again. He never holds more than one.

strings.endTreason: The fifth {term.hiyanet} passes. The counter-revolution wins.
strings.endLoyalty: The fourth {term.hizmet} passes. The Republic stands.
strings.pref.music.why: A quiet loop in the Dorian mode, in an uneven seven.
strings.lobby.shareText: Join my Entrika table; the Assembly is sitting. Room code: {code}
strings.err.exiled: Under {power.surgun}, this player can't be {term.minister:a} this {term.crisis}.
strings.log.surgun: {who} is held out by {power.surgun} this {term.crisis}: they can't be {term.minister:a}.
strings.lobby.learningWhy: Learning game: no {term.companion:pl}, {term.ambition:pl} or {term.favor} powers, and no outside Figures dealt.
strings.wait.kader: The Vote: nobody talks, nobody shows a card.
strings.log.kaderStart: Vote: {first} drafts the bills, {second} passes one.
